cards.title: Parenting Considerations for Raising Gifted Children
cards.body: Gifted and talented children present unique challenges in teaching and parenting. Understanding their needs helps parents support their development effectively.

cards.title: The Dark Side of Parent Support Groups
cards.body: Well-meaning parent groups can silence experts and spread misinformation. These spaces sometimes reward conformity over evidence-based advice.

cards.title: Parents of Ill Children Deserve Paid Leave
cards.body: Children's Commissioner Dame Rachel de Souza backs calls for paid leave support. Parents caring for seriously ill children need greater workplace protections.

cards.title: My Son Is Leaving Home for University
cards.body: Empty nesting hits harder than expected when your first-born departs. The emotional shift surprises even parents who anticipated this natural life phase.

cards.title: Music Festivals Work Better With Children
cards.body: Families add magic and joy to music festivals, not chaos. Parenting with young children doesn't mean sacrificing live culture and celebration.
